label: Royal Night-Elf Prince first encounter

purpose.value: In the moonlit ballroom, before the great mirror he practices ceremony in, the young ruler trained in diplomacy and performance issues the law's fair warning; the hero hears every word and misreads courtly ritual as sorcerous vanity. The guardian attempts communication first; the hero misreads it as a villain's taunt.

emotionalProgression.note: The guardian announces itself and its duty plainly, framed by the ballroom and its great mirror.
The warning was honest and complete; being ignored reads as insult.

notes: The scene MUST establish the guardian announcing itself and warning honestly — the law of fair warning means its attack paths will be shown, not hidden. The mercy exit (withdraw) is offered and never taken. Flavor: the ballroom and its great mirror. The player's view may hint the guardian's true role; the hero must not perceive it.
